scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,worker,client,admin -c blue,yellow,magenta,green "dotnet watch run --project backend/src/ReelGuo.Api" "dotnet run --project backend/src/ReelGuo.Worker" "pnpm --filter @reelguo/client dev" "pnpm --filter @reelguo/admin dev"
scripts.test: dotnet test --project backend/tests/ReelGuo.Api.Tests && pnpm -r typecheck && pnpm -r test
scripts.db:up: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml up -d postgres redis
